title: Remove Line Breaks
seoTitle: Remove Line Breaks — Join Lines Online Free
description: Remove all line breaks from a block of text and join everything into a single line or replace breaks with spaces. Private browser tool.
intro: Paste multi-line text and collapse it into one continuous line. Useful for cleaning copied paragraphs or preparing single-line data.
blurb: Join multi-line text into a single line by removing line breaks.
howItWorks: Paste or type text that contains line breaks.
Choose whether to replace each break with a space, nothing, or a comma.
Press the button and copy the single-line result.
examples: Three lines of a sentence become one paragraph when spaces are used.
A list of tags joined with commas for a form field.

faq.q: Does it remove only newlines or also spaces?
faq.a: It removes line break characters (\n and \r) and optionally inserts the replacement you choose. Existing spaces inside lines are kept.
Yes. The text never leaves your browser.
